title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: Logistic regression is used for binary classification problems. It predicts the probability that a given input point belongs to a certain class.

title: Logistic Function
text: The logistic function is a nonlinear function that maps any real-valued number into the $$(0,1)$$ interval, making it suitable for probability predictions.

title: Features in the Model
text: Consider how each feature (length, likes, response time) might influence whether a reply is from a bot or a human.

title: Logistic Regression Equation
text: The logistic regression model uses the equation: $$\ln\left(odds\right)$$ $$=$$ b0 + $$b1 x1$$ + $$b2 x2$$ + ... + $$bn xn$$, where odds $$=$$ $$\frac{p}{1-p}$$.

title: Probability Prediction
text: The probability that a reply is from a bot can be calculated using the logistic function: $$p$$ $$=$$ $$\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$, where $$z$$ $$=$$ b0 + $$b1 x1$$ + $$b2 x2$$ + ... + $$bn xn$$.
